subject.title: fix(launcher): stop respawned children after parent death on Unix

question: After the branch is refreshed, should maintainers accept a Unix child-side parent-death guard as the launcher lifecycle fix for the linked systemd restart issue?
rationale: The code path is a process-availability boundary, the PR is currently conflicting, and the proof is strong for the core SIGKILL behavior but not the exact systemd/root-owned restart scenario.

options.title: Refresh and land this guard
options.body: Resolve the conflicts, rerun the focused launcher/process checks, and land this parent-death guard or an equivalent implementation.

options.title: Require exact systemd proof first
options.body: Ask for a Linux systemd restart proof before merge if maintainer confidence requires the full reported service topology.

options.title: Pause for a different lifecycle design
options.body: Close or replace this PR if maintainers do not want an internal env-marker plus ppid polling guard in the respawn path.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land this guard
recommendation.body: Resolve the conflicts, rerun the focused launcher/process checks, and land this parent-death guard or an equivalent implementation.
